exercises.title: Rules to requirements 1 — rule or functional requirement?
exercises.problemHtml:
A business rule is an external statement of policy that drives system functionality; a functional requirement is the system behaviour that enforces it. They can look alike. Classify.

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Luật là chính sách bên ngoài; yêu cầu chức năng là hành vi hệ thống thực thi luật đó.

Mỗi dòng được chấm riêng; giải thích từng đáp án hiện sau khi nộp.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Rules to requirements 2 — derive functional requirements from rules
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers’ Chemical Tracking System example: rule #1 (action enabler) "if a container’s expiration date is reached, notify its holder"; rule #2 (fact) "a container that can form explosive decomposition products expires one year after manufacture". Write DERIVED: at least 3 functional requirements { id, text, rules: [...] } derived from these rules, each linked (by id) to the rule(s) it comes from: R1 and/or R2. Cover: computing the expiration date, notifying the holder, and identifying which containers have an expiration date.

Requirements

  • Do not copy the rule text — refer to the rule by id.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Từ hai luật của Chemical Tracking System, viết ≥ 3 yêu cầu chức năng có liên kết tới luật nguồn (R1, R2): tính ngày hết hạn, báo người giữ, xác định bình nào có hạn dùng.

Yêu cầu

  • Không chép lại nội dung luật — tham chiếu theo id.

examplesJson.output: { id: 'FR-1', text: 'The system shall set the expiration date of a container that can form explosive decomposition products to one year after its manufacture date.', rules: ['R2'] }

hintsJson: R2 (fact) ⇒ nhận diện bình + tính ngày; R1 (action enabler) ⇒ thông báo.
Mỗi yêu cầu ghi luật nguồn.

exercises.title: Rules to requirements 3 — linking rules and requirements
exercises.problemHtml:
To avoid redundancy, do not duplicate catalogue rules inside requirements — refer to the rule as the source. Link a requirement to its rules with an "origin" attribute in a requirements tool, with trace links in a matrix, or with hyperlinks to rule ids (fragile if the rules move).

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

Yêu cầu

  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Rules to requirements 4 — enforce in software or not?
exercises.problemHtml:
After identifying the rules, the BA decides which pertain to the application, which must be enforced in software, and how. Some rules are enforced by people or procedures instead.

Each question is graded on its own; the explanation appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

Mỗi câu được chấm riêng; giải thích hiện sau khi nộp.

# Rules to requirements 4 — enforce in software or not? — answer key

1. Rule: "Staff must wash their hands before handling samples." For a lab-management system this rule is…Luật: "Nhân viên phải rửa tay trước khi cầm mẫu." Với hệ thống quản lý phòng lab, luật này…
   Answer: a) enforced by procedure and training, not by the software
   Not every rule becomes software behaviour.VI: Không phải luật nào cũng thành hành vi phần mềm.

2. Rule: "A sample must be tested within 48 hours of collection." What might the software do?Luật: "Mẫu phải được xét nghiệm trong 48 giờ sau khi lấy." Phần mềm có thể làm gì?
   Answer: b) Warn the technician when a sample approaches 48 hours and report expired samples
   Derived functional requirements enforce the rule.VI: Yêu cầu chức năng phái sinh thực thi luật.
